title: UI-V2 owner-first experience + audit fixes: VN shell, governed NL intake, owner cockpit, ObjectiveDetail tabs, stale-scope guards, manual:true, typed failure reasons
description: Owner-first V2 UX on base ab0fccf. NEW governed NL intake: POST /api/v1/intake/draft returns a bounded deterministic draft + advisory semantic evidence (mode off/shadow/guarded/manual; plannerRunId:null → evidence NEVER pinned to a run; provider failure/malformed payload degrades to typed unavailable + manual draft; provider internals never echoed; only NotFoundError → 404, integrity errors propagate). Intake commits ONLY through canonical seams — objective → POST /api/vnext/objectives (dedup_key, existing service, noAuthPrompt); mission → /app/missions/new?goal= prefill (existing preview/confirm). Model prose never self-authorizes: provenance tags per field, explicit owner confirm, business required, business-drift between analyze→confirm blocks commit with re-analyze hint, manual:true bypasses analyzer (zero provider spend), malformed numerics blocked inline. Shell: owner-first VN nav + Nâng cao disclosure (all legacy /app/* routes preserved), dark-navy + light theme, mobile rail/bottom-tabs/drawer. Home cockpit reads canonical aggregates only — global reads once, business-scoped reads reset+abort-guarded on every switch (no cross-tenant stale render/overwrite), honest —/…/N+ states, PAUSED never counted running. ObjectiveDetail wraps all existing canonical sections in owner tabs (?tab= deep links, params preserved) — advanced controls under Nâng cao. Independent audit: no authority breach; FIX-REQUIRED findings (stale-scope race Home, analyze→confirm scope drift Intake, manual-button honesty, noAuthPrompt regression, typed reasons, busy-on-confirm, stale banner, malformed analysis, param loss) all fixed. E2E: ui-v2.spec.ts 9 tests + objectives/company/inbox-ceo specs reconciled to tabs (68/68), stale pre-BASE assertions corrected (A2-in-Inbox, kpi-verification status POST, scope-bound call counts). Known env baseline: no qualified planner route on this box → all mkMission/preview-dependent tests fail with FAIL_CLOSED_PLANNER_NO_ELIGIBLE (identical at BASE — template planner bypass removed pre-change).
